plugin_desc: Alpha Technologies Cordex HP DC plant SNMP child template for devices under Alpha PEN 7309. Interface traffic is supplied by the shared NetworkService SNMP IF-MIB floor rather than a plugin-side ifHC expansion. Proven rectifierSystem scalars are system voltage, total load current, battery voltage, battery current, battery temperature and maximum rectifier ambient temperature. Each ScaledNumber leaf is divided by 1000. CPU and memory scalars are not invented. Multi-system resource tables are not collected. Supported brands/models - Cordex HP controllers that expose rectifierSystem scalars and standard IF-MIB.
name: NetworkService

metrics.name: system_voltage_volts
metrics.description: DC plant system voltage in volts from rectifierSystem rectSysSystemVoltage (1.3.6.1.4.1.7309.5.3.1.10.0). The ScaledNumber integer is divided by 1000. Absent or sentinel values are dropped.

metrics.name: system_load_current_amps
metrics.description: DC plant total load current in amperes from rectifierSystem rectSysTotalLoadCurrent (1.3.6.1.4.1.7309.5.3.1.11.0). The ScaledNumber integer is divided by 1000. Absent or sentinel values are dropped.

metrics.name: battery_voltage_volts
metrics.description: Battery voltage in volts from rectifierSystem rectSysBatteryVoltage (1.3.6.1.4.1.7309.5.3.1.12.0). The ScaledNumber integer is divided by 1000. Absent or sentinel values are dropped.

metrics.name: battery_current_amps
metrics.description: Battery current in amperes from rectifierSystem rectSysBatteryCurrent (1.3.6.1.4.1.7309.5.3.1.13.0). The ScaledNumber integer is divided by 1000. Negative values are valid discharge current. Absent or sentinel values are dropped.

metrics.name: battery_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Battery temperature in degrees Celsius from rectifierSystem rectSysBatteryTemperature (1.3.6.1.4.1.7309.5.3.1.14.0). The ScaledNumber integer is divided by 1000. Absent or sentinel values are dropped.

metrics.name: rectifier_ambient_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Maximum rectifier ambient temperature in degrees Celsius from rectifierSystem rectMaxRectifierAmbientTemperature (1.3.6.1.4.1.7309.5.3.1.45.0). The ScaledNumber integer is divided by 1000. Absent or sentinel values are dropped.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of inbound bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of outbound bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
